# MetaForge

> Free SEO audit tool with AI readiness scoring. Audit any URL for ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews visibility. Checks llms.txt, JSON-LD structured data, meta tags, and social previews. Includes a validated meta tag generator.

## Tool

- AI Readiness Auditor & Meta Tag Generator: https://metaforge.app/

## What It Does

MetaForge fetches any URL server-side and runs a comprehensive audit across four categories:

### SEO Audit
- Title tag length (30-60 characters optimal)
- Meta description length (70-160 characters optimal)
- Canonical URL presence and validity
- H1 tag count (exactly one required)
- Image alt text coverage
- Internal and external link count

### AI Readiness Audit (the moat — no competitor does this)
- JSON-LD structured data detection and type extraction
- llms.txt file detection at site root
- Robots directive check (noindex detection)
- Content depth analysis (300+ words recommended)
- AI crawler accessibility (GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot)

### Social Sharing Audit
- Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, og:type)
- Twitter Card tags (twitter:card, twitter:title, twitter:description, twitter:image)
- Social preview rendering

### Accessibility Audit
- Viewport meta tag presence
- HTML lang attribute
- Favicon presence
- Image alt text coverage

## Meta Tag Generator

- Generates validated HTML meta tags
- Real-time validation against current specs
- 8 JSON-LD schema types (WebPage, Article, BlogPosting, Product, Organization, LocalBusiness, FAQPage, HowTo)
- Google SERP preview
- Facebook and Twitter social card previews
- One-click copy to clipboard

## Scoring

Each audit produces a 0-100 score across four categories, weighted into an overall score:
- SEO: 30%
- AI Readiness: 35%
- Social: 20%
- Accessibility: 15%
